newsitem.title: USA: Whole Foods to post Q4 charge, Q4 sales up.
newsitem.headline: Whole Foods to post Q4 charge, Q4 sales up.

text.p: Whole Foods Market Inc said Wednesday it expects to record a charge against fourth-quarter results of about $32 million.
Separately, the company also announed that sales in the fourth quarter were $230 million, up 24 percent from the year-ago period.
The charges were listed in four segments:
* Severance and other merger costs will amount to $11 million.
* Asset write-offs and the cost of store closings also related to the June announcement of its merger with Fresh Fields Inc will amount to 16 million.
* The write-off of duplicate computer/operating systems will amount to $5 million.
* Damage to inventory from Hurrican Fran will amount to $200,000.
The company said it plans to release its full fourth-quarter results in early November.
